## Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Loading output data from 01_load

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# Load datasets into environment
data_path <- "../data/"

pam50_filtered <- read_tsv(str_c(data_path, "01_dat_load_final_with_control_pam50_filtered.tsv"),
                           show_col_types = FALSE)
all_genes  <- read_tsv(str_c(data_path, "01_dat_load_final_with_control_dataset_all_genes.tsv"),
                       show_col_types = FALSE)
```

### Removing all NA values from the PAM50 filtered data

```{r}
pam50_filtered_without_NA <- pam50_filtered |> 
  select(-(where(anyNA) & !starts_with("PAM50")))
```

```{r}
head(pam50_filtered_without_NA)
```

### Removing all NA values from the all genes data

```{r}
all_genes_without_NA <- all_genes |> 
  select(-(where(anyNA) & !starts_with("PAM50")))
```

```{r}
head(all_genes_without_NA)
```

### Save the final tibbles as tsv files in the data folder

```{r}
write_tsv(pam50_filtered_without_NA, 
          file = str_c(data_path, "02_dat_clean_pam50_filtered_without_NA.tsv"))
write_tsv(all_genes_without_NA, 
          file = str_c(data_path, "02_dat_clean_all_genes_without_NA.tsv"))
```
